"exit all my lending positions" is read as exit-all (position custody, category lending); the solver asks the scope when a network could not be read, then lists every withdraw in a moves confirm.
"go 100% stablecoins on base" is a rebalance on the asset axis (any-stable 10 000 bps, scope Base); every computed swap is listed in a moves confirm.
"fund alice.eth with 25 usdc on base" is the payment "send 25 usdc to alice.eth on base" (rule abstract:fund); amount, token, network and recipient are copied as typed; equals the corpus plan.
"wrap 0.1 eth on base" is the 1:1 wrap step, read as the swap ETH -> WETH on Base (rule abstract:wrap); amount and network as typed.
The payment purpose "rent of" is consumed by rule abstract:paymentPurpose; the payment is read as typed and equals the corpus plan.
"make sure alice.eth gets exactly 50 usdc on arbitrum" is one exact transfer of the stated amount on Arbitrum (rule abstract:exactly); equals the corpus plan.
"close everything on base" is exit-all of the positions on Base; every withdraw is listed in a moves confirm.
"with the best provider" is a best-venue phrase: the solver ranks the staking provider (default chip); amount half of the SOL as before; equals the corpus plan.
"even out my usdc between base and arbitrum" is a network-axis rebalance 50/50; the one computed bridge is listed in a moves confirm and equals the corpus plan.
"withdraw all my usdc from everywhere" is exit-all of USDC positions on every network; unread networks are asked (SCOPE_AMBIGUOUS), never treated as empty.
"on the safest venue" is a best-venue phrase: the deposit of the USDC on Base goes to the ranked venue (default chip), as "put my usdc to work on base" reads; equals the corpus plan.
"get my sol ready for a payment of 50 usdc on solana" is a SOL -> 50 USDC exact-output swap on Solana (rule abstract:ensure); the SOL amount is priced (chip); equals the corpus plan shape.
